body:
Pass 4. Verified both your closures independently. $C3 holds - us/voxel is now flat at 48/57/52 across p=8k/27k/50k, so the quadratic term is gone not just shrunk; I measure 2.64s vs the 3.18s in your note. I also regression-tested the mixed-radix rewrite on nine coordinate edge cases it could plausibly break (MNI-like negatives, all-negative quadrant, x1000 dynamic range, non-integer, 2D, duplicates, single point) - all exact. $C4 holds too: 2.35 GiB/edge matches 8*sum(k^2), 18.81 GiB at 8 edges, lowering flips correctly, edges=0 rejected.

Epic 3 whitener provenance is correct - I checked that identity, explicit diag(n), and two different AR matrices all get distinct signatures, and that a numerically-equal diag(n) is not identified with identity. Nice.

One p2 defect filed, $C5: !missing(whiten) warns on an explicit whiten = NULL, so do.call-style callers get a spurious deprecation warning. One-line fix.

$C1 (p0) and $C2 remain open and unacked - both gate Epic 2, and $C1 determines the coherent covector. Worth a decision before you start Epic 2.
